blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 生物医学语言模型(LM)为临床任务提供了很强的表示力,但它们往往无法捕捉到医学概念中的分级结构. 这种限制对于长尾词组中稀有和精细的临床代码特别明显,随着概念频率的降低,分级-不可知的LM表达变得信息较少. 我们引入了语义医学识别器(SMI),这是构建基于本体学的语义特征和分级意识医学概念表述的无培训框架. 对于每个诊断,程序,或药物概念,SMI通过专家定义的医学本体学,将它的语义ID定义为粗到细的路径. SMI然后将冰冻的生物医学LM嵌入到相应的肿瘤层面,以形成分级-有意识的医学概念表述来保存粗细的临床语义. 基础SMI采用跨本体学层次的统一聚合,而水平加权变体则在验证数据上选择全球水平加权. 我们的理论分析显示,SMI产生比分级-不可知LM嵌入法更丰富的医学概念表现,特别是对于稀有和精细的临床概念. 实验显示SMI捕捉到有意义的分级结构并改进了临床关系预测. 关于MIMIC-IV,SMI改进了死亡率预测,再接收预测,药物推荐,以及罕见的药物预测. 在医院间疾病分类中,在跨医院分布变化的情况下,社会疾病分类的病人表现更加有力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The widespread adoption of electronic health record (EHR) systems has produced large-scale clinical data, enabling broad applications of language models (LMs) in healthcare. Biomedical LMs learn generalizable clinical representations for downstream tasks such as diagnosis prediction, drug recommendation, and patient risk stratification ( Song et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . However, most biomedical LMs remain predominantly data-driven and struggle to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. Clinical coding systems such as the International Classification of Diseases (ICD) and the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) organize diagnoses, procedures, and medications into multi-level taxonomies, ranging from broad categories to fine-grained codes ( Steindel, 2010 ; Chen et al., 2012 ) . Without explicitly modeling these medical ontologies, hierarchy-agnostic LMs encode each medical concept largely from its single-level textual description ( Gao et al., 2019 ) , limiting their ability to preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics.
blocks.zh: 广泛采用电子健康记录系统产生了大规模临床数据,使得语言模型在保健领域得到了广泛的应用。 生物医学LM为诊断预测,药物推荐,患者风险分层等下游任务学习了可概括的临床表现(宋等,2024;宋等,2025;王等,2026). 然而,大多数生物医学遗留问题仍然以数据为主,为掌握医学概念的分级结构而挣扎。 国际疾病分类(ICD)和解剖治疗化学(ATC)等临床编码系统将诊断,程序和药物组织成多层次分类,范围从大类到精细编码不等(Steindel,2010;Chen等,2012.). 没有明确的模型 这些医学本体, 等级-不可知 LMS主要从其单层文字描述(Gao等,2019年)来编码每个医学概念,限制了它们保存粗细临床语义的能力.

blocks.en: To demonstrate this limitation, we evaluated ICD 1-hop prediction using BioBERT, a common medical LM pre-trained on PubMed abstracts and PMC articles ( Lee et al., 2020 ) , and our Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI). This task evaluates whether a child concept is embedded closer to its true parent than to unrelated concepts. As shown in Fig. 1 a, BioBERT performs reasonably well at the coarsest levels (85.1%), but its accuracy deteriorates rapidly as the hierarchy becomes finer, dropping to 58.6% at the finest level. The drop is most severe for fine-grained concepts, which are far more numerous and rarer in EHR data, making their embeddings harder to learn reliably (Fig. 7 ). To further examine this long-tail effect, we stratified fine-grained ICD concepts by frequency and evaluated 1-hop prediction. As shown in Fig. 1 b, BioBERT accuracy decreases as concept frequency decreases, indicating that hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings are vulnerable to long-tailed clinical code distributions. In contrast, SMI maintains strong and stable accuracy across frequency bins, suggesting that medical ontology structure can help mitigate representation degradation for infrequent fine-grained concepts. These observations motivate leveraging expert-defined medical ontologies to improve representations of long-tailed clinical codes under data scarcity.
blocks.zh: 为了证明这一局限性,我们利用生物生物实验T(PubMed摘要和PMC文章(Lee等,2020年)上的普通医学LM预训)和我们的语义医学识别器(SMI)评估了ICD 1-hop预测。 这项任务评价儿童概念是否与其真正的父母关系更为密切,不如说与无关的概念更为密切。 如图1a所示,BioBERT在最低等水平(85.1%)的性能相当好,但随着等级结构的细化,其准确性迅速恶化,在最佳水平上下降到58.6%。 对于精细的概念来说,下降最为严重,在EHR数据中,这些概念数量要多得多,也比较少见,使得它们的嵌入更难可靠地学习(图7). 为了进一步审查这种长尾效应,我们按频率分出精细的ICD概念,并评价了1-跳的预测. 如图1b所示,BioBERT精度会随着概念频率的降低而降低,表明分级-可知LM嵌入物容易受到长尾临床代码分布的影响. 相形之下,SMI在频率箱中保持了强而稳定的精度,这表明医学本体结构可以帮助缓解不常见的细纹概念的表达退化. 这些观测促使利用专家定义的医学本体学来改进数据稀缺情况下长尾临床代码的表述.

blocks.en: Prior structure-aware approaches for medical concept representation broadly fall into two categories. The first learns structure-aware concept embeddings by incorporating curated biomedical resources such as UMLS ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , knowledge graphs ( Sakhovskiy et al., 2024 ) , and ontologies ( He et al., 2024 ) , but usually requires additional structure-aware training. The second develops task-specific prediction models that use ontology structure ( Choi et al., 2017 ; Shang et al., 2019 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) , but these methods are optimized for specific tasks rather than general-purpose concept representation across clinical applications. These limitations leave a gap for a hierarchy-aware framework that directly constructs concept representations without training an explicit ontology encoder or making representation construction dependent on a particular downstream task. SMI addresses this gap by directly aggregating frozen, level-specific LM embeddings along expert-defined medical ontology paths to construct hierarchy-aware medical concept representations without additional training.
blocks.zh: 医疗概念代表性的前期结构意识方法大致分为两类。 最早通过将UMLS(Liu等,2021年),知识图(Sakhovskiy等,2024年),和本体学(He等,2024年)等被整理的生物医学资源融合起来来学习结构意识概念嵌入,但通常需要额外的结构意识培训. 二是开发使用肿瘤结构的具体任务预测模型(Choi等,2017;Shang等,2019;Tan等,2025),但这些方法被优化用于具体任务,而不是临床应用的通用概念代表. 这些限制给分级认识框架留下了空白,这种框架直接构建概念表述,而没有培训明确的本体编码器,或者使表述构建依赖于特定的下游任务. SMI解决了这一差距,直接将冰冻的、具体层次的LM嵌入在专家定义的医学本体学路径上,在没有额外培训的情况下构建有分级意识的医学概念表述.

blocks.en: In this study, we introduce SMI, a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. SMI derives Semantic IDs from expert-defined medical ontologies. Diagnosis and procedure concepts are represented using coarse-to-fine ICD taxonomy, while medication concepts follow the ATC taxonomy. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings along each Semantic ID to form a hierarchy-aware medical concept representation that preserves coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI assigns equal importance to all hierarchy levels, while a level-weighted variant accounts for their different contributions by selecting a global weight for each level on validation data. Theoretically, we show that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Empirically, clinical relation prediction experiments show that SMI produces concept representations that better align with medical ontology structure, improving relation prediction within ICD and ATC as well as cross-ontology ICD-to-ATC prediction. On the MIMIC-IV dataset, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, and drug recommendation, with particularly strong gains in rare drug prediction. On the eICU dataset, SMI shows significantly smaller cross-hospital distribution shifts than BioBERT, indicating improved cross-site robustness.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们引入了SMI,这是建立基于本体论的语义特征和有分级意识的医学概念表述的无培训框架. SMI从专家定义的医学本体学中获取语义识别. 诊断和程序概念使用粗细的ICD分类法来表示,而药物概念遵循ATC分类法. SMI然后将冰冻的生物医学LM嵌入于每个语义ID上,以形成一个分级-有意识的医学概念代表,保留粗到细的临床语义. 基础SMI对所有等级级别都给予同等重视,而一个等级加权变量则通过为每个等级的验证数据选择一个全局权重来说明其不同的贡献. 理论上,我们显示,SMI产生比分级-不可知LM嵌入更丰富的医学概念表述,特别是对于稀有和精细的临床概念. 从经验上看,临床关系预测实验显示,SMI能产生出更能与医学肿瘤结构相适应的概念表示,改善了ICD和ATC内部的关系预测以及跨肿瘤ICD-到ATC的预测. 在MIMIC-IV数据集上,SMI改进了死亡率预测,再入药预测和药物推荐,在稀有药物预测上特别大有收获. 在eICU数据集上,SMI显示相较于BioBERT的跨医院分布变化明显较小,表明跨站点稳健性得到提高.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work on biomedical concept representation with external knowledge mainly follows two directions. One direction learns structure-aware concept embeddings by injecting curated biomedical resources into representation learning. Existing methods use UMLS synonym sets ( Sung et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) , ontology definitions and descriptions ( Remy et al., 2022 ; Remy et al., 2024 ) , biomedical knowledge graphs ( Zou et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2022 ; Sakhovskiy et al., 2024 ) , and medical ontologies ( He et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . While these methods improve concept embeddings using external biomedical knowledge, they typically require additional training rather than the direct use of frozen LM representations.
The other direction develops supervised downstream prediction models that incorporate ontology structure through ontology-guided aggregation ( Choi et al., 2017 ) , graph-augmented patient modeling ( Shang et al., 2019 ) , expert-guided topic modeling ( Song et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , or structure-semantics fusion ( Tan et al., 2025 ) . These methods are trained for specific predictive tasks, whereas SMI constructs task-agnostic concept representations for downstream clinical applications.
In contrast, SMI uses expert-defined ontology paths to construct hierarchy-aware concept representations from frozen LM embeddings without training.
blocks.zh:
先前关于具有外部知识的生物医学概念代表性的工作主要遵循两个方向。 一个方向是通过向代表性学习中注入精密生物医学资源来学习结构意识概念。 现有方法使用UMLS同义词集(Sung等,2020;Liu等,2021),肿瘤学定义和描述(Remy等,2022;Remy等,2024),生物医学知识图. (Zou等,2022;Yuan等,2022;Sakhovskiy等,2024),和医学本体学(He等,2024;Yang等,2025.). 虽然这些方法利用外部生物医学知识改进了概念嵌入,但它们通常需要更多的培训,而不是直接使用被冻结的LM表示.
另一方向则通过肿瘤指导聚合(Choi等,2017年),图解患者模型(Sang等,2019年),专家指导专题模型(Song等,2022年;Yang等,2026年),或结构-语义聚变(Tan等,2025年),开发包含肿瘤结构的有监督的下游预测模型. 这些方法是为具体的预测性任务而训练的,而SMI则为下游临床应用构建任务不可知的概念表述.
相形之下,SMI使用由专家定义的本体学路径,从冷冻的LM嵌入中构建出分级-意识的概念表达.

blocks.en:
Semantic IDs represent entities as structured sequences of discrete codes, allowing semantically related entities to share common prefixes and capture coarse-to-fine semantic structure. TIGER constructs hierarchical Semantic IDs by applying a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) to item content embeddings Rajput et al. (2023) . Subsequent work further improves learned Semantic IDs by aligning language and collaborative information Zheng et al. (2024) , incorporating collaborative signals into item tokenization ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and jointly learning item tokens with the downstream model Liu et al. (2025) .
These methods construct discrete identifiers through learned quantization or tokenization. In contrast, SMI derives ontology-grounded Semantic IDs directly from expert-defined medical ontologies, with each Semantic ID corresponding to a medical concept’s coarse-to-fine ontology path. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings along these ontology paths to construct hierarchy-aware medical concept representations without training an additional quantizer or tokenization model.
blocks.zh:
语义 ID代表实体作为离散代码的结构化序列,可以使与集合相关的实体共享共同的前缀并捕获粗到细的语义结构. TIGER通过对嵌入了Rajput等人(2023年)的项目内容采用残留-定量变异自编码器(RQ-VAE)来构建分级语义ID. 随后的工作进一步提高了所学的语义标识,将语言和协作信息"郑等"(2024年)相统一,将协作信号收录到项目符号化(Wang等,2024年),与下游模式"刘等"(2025年)共同学习项目符号.
这些方法通过所学得的量化或示意来构建离散识别器. 相对而言,SMI直接从专家定义的医学本体学中获得基于本体学的语义学ID,每个语义学ID对应的是医学概念的粗到细的本体学路径. SMI然后沿着这些本体学路径将被冻结的生物医学LM嵌入来构建有分级意识的医学概念表述,而无需再训练出额外的分解器或标注模型.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of SMI and hierarchy-aware medical concept embedding. a . An expert-curated medical ontology organizes clinical concepts from coarse to fine levels. b . A frozen biomedical LM encodes clinical codes at each ontology level into level-specific embeddings. c . SMI represents each medical concept by its coarse-to-fine ontology path as a Semantic ID and aggregates the corresponding embeddings to form a hierarchy-aware medical concept representation.
blocks.zh: 图2:SMI和分级意识医学概念嵌入的概况. 页:1 经专家鉴定的医学肿瘤学组织临床概念从粗到细. 页:1 被冻结的生物医学LM将每个肿瘤层面的临床代码编码为各层次特定的嵌入. c. SMI通过粗细到精细的本体学路径作为语义ID代表了每一个医学概念,并汇总了相应的嵌入物以形成分层意识医学概念代表.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: This section presents the SMI framework for hierarchy-aware concept representation of clinical codes, including diagnoses, procedures, and medications. Section 3.1 describes the construction of medical ontologies. Section 3.2 introduces the SMI framework. Section 3.3 provides a theoretical analysis showing that SMI yields more informative representations than hierarchy-agnostic LMs.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍临床编码的分级认识概念体现的SMI框架,包括诊断、程序和药物。 第3.1节描述了医学本体学的构建. 第3.2节介绍了最低运作标准框架。 第3.3节提供了一项理论分析,显示与等级不可知的LMs相比,SMI能产生更多的信息说明.

blocks.en: 3.1 Expert-Curated Medical Ontologies
blocks.zh: 3.1 专家诊断医学

blocks.en: Clinical coding systems, such as ICD and ATC, organize diagnoses, procedures, and medications through multi-level taxonomies ranging from broad categories to fine-grained conditions. We organize clinical concepts into distinct five-level hierarchies, where each code has a unique path. For diagnostic codes, we adopt the Clinical Classifications Software (CCS) diagnostic taxonomy and construct a hierarchy of Major category → \rightarrow Sub-category → \rightarrow CCS code → \rightarrow ICD-CM code (integer) → \rightarrow ICD-CM code (decimal). For procedure codes, we follow the CCS procedure taxonomy and construct a five-level hierarchy: major category, sub-category, CCS code, prefix ICD-PCS code (first three characters), and full ICD-PCS code. For medications, we leverage the inherent five-level hierarchy of the ATC system: Anatomical Main Group → \rightarrow Therapeutic Subgroup → \rightarrow Pharmacological Subgroup → \rightarrow Chemical Subgroup → \rightarrow Chemical Substance. We provide the construction procedure and key statistics of medical ontologies in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 临床编码系统,如ICD和ATC,通过多层次的分类法组织诊断,程序和药物,从大类到精细的分泌. 我们把临床概念组织成不同的五级等级,其中每个代码都有独特的路径. 关于诊断码,我们采用临床分类软件诊断分类法,并构建主要类别---------------------------------------------------------------------的分级。 关于程序代码,我们遵循CCS程序分类法,构建一个五级分级:主要类别,子类别,CCS代码,前缀ICD-PCS代码(前三个字符)和完整的ICD-PCS代码. 在药物方面,我们利用ATC系统固有的五级结构: 解剖学主要小组 —— 右侧治疗分组 —— 右侧药理学分组 —— 右侧化学分组 —— 右侧化学物质。 我们在附录C中提供了建筑程序和医学本体学的关键统计数据。

blocks.en: 3.3 Theoretical Analysis of LM Representation Collapse and SMI Informativeness
blocks.zh: 3.3 对LM代表的理论分析

blocks.en: We consider two embedding paradigms for clinical concepts. A hierarchy-agnostic LM embedding 𝐞 i LM \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{LM}} is obtained by directly encoding the textual description of concept i i with a biomedical LM. In contrast, our proposed hierarchy-aware SMI embedding 𝐞 i SMI \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{SMI}} aggregates embeddings of all ancestor concepts along its hierarchical path. Both aim to estimate the latent semantic vector 𝝁 i \bm{\mu}_{i} . However, 𝐞 i LM \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{LM}} depends only on data-driven textual signal, whereas 𝐞 i SMI \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{SMI}} leverages higher-frequency ancestor information to reduce estimation noise variance and thus improves representations. All proofs in this section are detailed in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Prior work has shown that word frequency affects contextualized embedding quality in LMs ( Schick and Schütze, 2020b ; Schick and Schütze, 2020a ) , which is consistent with our observation in Fig. 1 b that BioBERT accuracy declines for less frequent concepts. Motivated by these findings, we model hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings 𝐞 i LM \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{LM}} as frequency-dependent noisy estimates of latent concept semantics 𝝁 i \bm{\mu}_{i} , with estimation variance decreasing as frequency n i n_{i} increases. Because clinical vocabularies are long-tailed (Table 7 ), many fine-grained concepts have small n i n_{i} and thus noise-dominated embeddings. This motivates the following frequency-dependent estimation assumption.

blocks.en: Theorem 3.3 shows that, in long-tailed clinical vocabularies, hierarchy-agnostic LMs produce noise-dominated embeddings for infrequent fine-grained concepts, causing semantic separability to degrade at finer hierarchy levels.

blocks.en: Pairwise distances between infrequent fine-grained concepts concentrate in a narrow “noise shell,” making their representations geometrically indistinguishable. Thus, 1-hop prediction with hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings degrades to near-random results (Fig. 1 a).

blocks.en: Inspired by the additive compositionality of word embeddings ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) , we model a fine-grained concept as the sum of its coarse-grained parent semantics and a child-specific semantic offset. Proposition 3.6 shows that SMI embeddings are separable from non-parent concepts even for infrequent fine-grained concepts, whereas Theorem 3.3 indicates that hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings are inseparable. Although both approaches estimate the same latent semantics, SMI improves representations by reducing embedding variance rather than increasing semantic margins. By aggregating higher-frequency ancestor embeddings, SMI reduces noise in infrequent fine-grained concepts. This leads to the following theorem, which establishes that SMI achieves strictly higher SNR than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings by reducing estimation noise variance.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 SMI Embeddings Capture Clinical Concept Relations
blocks.zh: 4.1 萨米群岛 临床概念关系

blocks.en: To assess whether SMI embeddings capture clinical relations in medical ontologies, we evaluated multi-hop relation prediction within the ICD and ATC hierarchies by predicting ancestor–descendant links within each hierarchy. We also evaluated a cross-ontology 1-hop relation prediction between treatments and their corresponding diagnoses (ICD → \rightarrow ATC). The experimental setup is provided in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估SMI是否将临床关系嵌入到医学本体学中,我们通过预测各个层次中的祖先-后人联系,评估了ICD和ATC等级内的多跳关系预测. 我们还评估了治疗与其相应诊断(ICD →\rightarrow ATC)之间的跨肿瘤一跳关系预测. 试验设置载于附录E.2。

blocks.en: We compared SMI with three groups of baselines: (1) the hierarchy-agnostic LM backbone BioBERT ( Lee et al., 2020 ) ; (2) LMs with structure knowledge, including SapBERT ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , HiTs ( He et al., 2024 ) , OnT ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and BERGAMOT ( Sakhovskiy et al., 2024 ) ; and (3) structure-aware embedding baselines, including RotatE ( Sun et al., 2019 ) and cui2vec ( Beam et al., 2020 ) . Implementation details are provided in Appendix D.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们把SMI与三组基线进行了比较:(1) 等级-不可知LM骨干BioBERT(李等,2020年);(2) 有结构知识的LMs,包括SapBERT(刘等,2021年),HiTs(他等,2024年),OnT(杨等,2025年),和BERGAMOT(Sakhovskiy等,2024年);和(3) 有结构意识的嵌入基线,包括Rotate(Sun等,2019年)和cui2vec(Beam等,2020年). 执行情况详情见附录D.4。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , SMI and SMI-W achieve the best performance across all three relation types, outperforming all baseline groups. For within-ontology prediction, SMI-W obtains the highest F-scores on ICD (71.5%) and ATC (77.5%), substantially improving over the strongest baseline SapBERT on ICD (67.1%) and ATC (74.5%). This indicates that weighting hierarchy levels helps capture parent-child relationships more effectively. Cross-ontology prediction (ICD → \rightarrow ATC) is challenging because methods trained within each ontology may not directly align diagnosis and medication semantics. Despite this, SMI-W achieves the best Precision (53.6%), Recall (62.2%), and F-score (57.6%), outperforming the strongest baseline HiTs with F-score 53.2%. These results suggest that aggregating frozen biomedical LM embeddings along ontology-grounded Semantic IDs improves medical concept representations for both within-ontology and cross-ontology relation prediction tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,SMI和SMI-W在所有三种关系类型中都取得了最佳业绩,超过了所有基准组。 就肿瘤内部预测而言,SMI-W在ICD(71.5%)和ATC(77.5%)上获得最高的F分数,比在ICD(67.1%)和ATC(74.5%)上获得的最强基线SapBERT大有改进。 这表明权重等级水平有助于更有效地捕捉亲子关系. 交叉肿瘤学预测(ICD →\rightarrow ATC)具有挑战性,因为在每个肿瘤学中培训的方法可能不能直接使诊断和药物语义一致. 尽管如此,SMI-W还是取得了最好的精度(53.6%),召回(62.2%)和F分数(57.6%),以F分数53.2%的成绩超过了最强的基准Hits. 这些结果表明,将冰冻的生物医学LM嵌入到基于肿瘤的语义特征上,可以改进医学概念的表述,既用于肿瘤内的关系,也用于交叉肿瘤关系预测任务。

blocks.en: 4.2 SMI Embeddings Capture Medical Ontology Structure
blocks.zh: 4.2 海事局 医学肿瘤结构

blocks.en: We applied the Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) to visualize ICD diagnosis embeddings in 2D ( McInnes et al., 2018 ) . Each point represents a decimal-level ICD code with frequency ≥ 5 \geq 5 and is colored by its major disease category. As shown in Fig. 3 , BioBERT embeddings are highly mixed across major categories, indicating that hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings do not clearly separate disease groups. In contrast, SMI embeddings form more distinct clusters by major disease category and further split into coherent subgroups that align with subcategories in the medical ontology. This comparison suggests that hierarchy-aware aggregation helps SMI capture clinically meaningful structure that is not evident from hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings.
blocks.zh: 我们应用了"统一马尼弗外观和投影"(UMAP)将ICD诊断嵌入到2D的可视化(McInnes等,2018年). 每个点代表一个小数级的ICD编码,频率为~5\geq 5,并被其主要疾病类别所取色. 如图3所示,BioBERT嵌入物在主要类别中高度混合,表明分级-不可知LM嵌入物没有明显区分出疾病群体. 相形之下,SMI嵌入物按主要疾病类别组成了更相区别的集群,并被进一步划分为与医学本体学中的子类相适应的连贯分群. 这种比较表明,分级意识聚合有助于SMI捕捉临床上有意义的结构,从分级不可知的LM嵌入物中看不出来.

blocks.en: To quantify whether the embeddings align with the ICD ontology, we applied K-means clustering with the number of clusters set to the number of major disease categories. As shown in Table 10 , SMI achieves stronger ontology-consistent clustering than BioBERT, with higher NMI (0.77 vs. 0.39), ARI (0.56 vs. 0.25), and Purity (0.78 vs. 0.51). SMI also improves per-category clustering quality, increasing Recall from 0.41 to 0.80 and Precision from 0.35 to 0.61, indicating more coherent grouping within the same major category. In addition, SMI better separates ICD major categories, with a higher Silhouette score (0.52 vs. 0.04) and a lower Intra/Inter Ratio (0.29 vs. 0.82). Full aggregate and per-category clustering results with detailed analyses are provided in Appendix E.3 .
blocks.zh: 为了量化嵌入物是否与ICD本体学一致,我们应用了K-指由被设定为主要疾病类别数的集群数来组合. 如表10所显示,SMI比BioBERT实现更强的肿瘤-一致性集群,NMI更高(0.77对0.39),ARI(0.56对0.25)和Purity(0.78对0.51). SMI还提高了每类分组的质量,将召回率从0.41提高到了0.80;精度从0.35提高到了0.61,表明在同一主要类别内分组更加一致。 此外,SMI较好地分离出ICD主要类别,Silhouette得分较高(0.52对0.04),内部/内部比分较低(0.29对0.82). 附录E.3提供了附有详细分析的全面汇总结果和每类分组结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation on MIMIC-IV and eICU EHR Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.3 对MIMIC-IV和ECU EHR数据集的评价

blocks.en:
We evaluated SMI medical concept representations on two EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and eICU Johnson et al. (2023) ; Pollard et al. (2018) . As the first EHR dataset, we used MIMIC - IV for clinical prediction tasks, including mortality and readmission prediction as well as drug recommendation. We extracted clinical codes from 123,488 patients and mapped them to their corresponding five-level Semantic IDs.
As the second EHR dataset, we used the eICU dataset to evaluate distribution shifts in patient observations across hospitals using both SMI and BioBERT embedding methods. We mapped diagnoses and medications to 72 unique integer-level ICD-9 codes and 241 unique five-level ATC codes. We selected the 10 hospitals with the largest number of patients, resulting in a total of 24,179 patients and an average of 2,418 patients per hospital. We split each dataset into training, validation, and test sets using a 70%/10%/20% split.
Detailed settings for the MIMIC-IV clinical prediction tasks and the eICU distribution shift analysis are provided in Sections 4.4 and 4.5 , respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们用MIMI-IV和eICU Johnson等人(2023年);Pollard等人(2018年)两个EHR数据集评价了SMI的医疗概念表述。 作为第一个EHR数据集,我们使用了MIMIC - IV来完成临床预测任务,包括死亡率和再接收预测以及药物推荐. 我们从123,488名病人那里提取了临床代码,并将其映射到相应的五等语义ID.
作为第二套EHR数据集,我们使用eICU数据集,使用SMI和BioBERT嵌入法来评价各医院患者观察的分布变化. 我们将诊断和药物绘制为72个独特的整数级ICD-9编码和241个独特的五级ATC编码。 我们选择了病人最多的10所医院,共计24,179名病人,平均每所医院有2,418名病人。 我们用70%/10%/20%的分数将每个数据集分为培训、验证和测试集。
第4.4和4.5节分别提供了MIMIC-IV临床预测任务的详细设置和ECU分布转移分析.

blocks.en: 4.4 SMI Improves Clinical Prediction and Rare Drug Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.4 SMI 改进临床预测和罕见药物预测

blocks.en: For clinical prediction, we extracted diagnosis, procedure, and medication codes from MIMIC-IV and evaluated three common tasks. Mortality prediction assesses whether a patient has died within 90 days after discharge. Readmission prediction assesses whether a patient is readmitted within the next 15 days after discharge. Drug recommendation predicts the set of medications for each visit given the patient’s prior clinical history. Mortality and readmission are binary classification tasks evaluated with Area Under Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) and Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC). Drug recommendation is a multi-label prediction task evaluated with AUPRC, F-score, and Jaccard. We also predicted rare drugs using 98 ATC codes with frequency between 10 and 20, using Recall of top 15 predictions as a metric. We mapped clinical codes to their SMI embeddings and used mean pooling over tokens for a patient-level representation. We compared with two groups of baselines: (1) clinical concept embedding methods such as GRAM ( Choi et al., 2017 ) , cui2vec ( Beam et al., 2020 ) , and RotatE ( Sun et al., 2019 ) ; (2) biomedical LMs including BioBERT ( Lee et al., 2020 ) , SapBERT ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , G-BERT ( Shang et al., 2019 ) , BEHRT ( Li et al., 2020 ) , ClinicalBERT ( Alsentzer et al., 2019 ) , BoxLM ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , and BERGAMOT ( Sakhovskiy et al., 2024 ) . We provided implementation details in Appendix D.4 .
blocks.zh: 为了进行临床预测,我们从MIMIC-IV中提取了诊断、程序和药物编码,并评估了三项共同任务。 死亡率预测评估患者是否在出院后90天内死亡. 重新入境预测评估患者是否在出院后15天内重新入境。 药物推荐预估每一次就诊的药物种类,因为患者以前有过临床史。 死亡率和重新接纳是用精确召回曲线下的区域(AUPRC)和接收器操作特征下的区域(AUROC)评价的二进制分类任务. 药物推荐是一项多标签的预测任务,与非盟炼油厂、F分和Jaccard一起评估。 我们还预测了使用频率在10到20之间的98个ATC代码的稀有药物,使用前15个预测作为度量. 我们绘制了临床代码, 以他们的SMI嵌入, 并使用平均集合 超过标志, 以病人一级的代表。 我们比较了两类基线:(1) 临床概念嵌入方法,如GRAM(Choi等人,2017年),cui2vec (Beam等,2020年),和罗塔特. (Sun等,2019年; (2)生物医学LMs 包括 BioBERT (Lee等,2020年), SapBERT (Liu等,2021年), G-BERT (Shang等,2019年), BEHRT (Li等,2020年), ClinicalBERT. (Alsentzer等人,2019年),Box LM (Tan等人,2025年),和BERGAMOT (Sakhovskiy等人,2024年). 我们提供了附录D.4的执行细节。

blocks.en: Table 3: Clinical prediction results on MIMIC-IV for mortality, readmission, and (rare) drug recommendation, comparing SMI with two groups of baselines. Metrics are reported as mean (standard error) from bootstrap. The best results in each column are highlighted in bold.
blocks.zh: 表3:关于MIMIC-IV的死亡、重新接纳和(很少)药物建议临床预测结果,将SMI与两类基线进行比较。 计量法报告为靴子上的平均值(标准误差)。 每栏的最佳结果以黑体突出。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 3 , SMI and SMI-W consistently improve clinical prediction on MIMIC-IV. SMI and SMI-W generally achieve stronger mortality and readmission prediction performance than the baselines in terms of AUPRC and AUROC. The gains are especially clear for drug recommendation, where SMI-W achieves the best AUPRC, F-score, and Jaccard scores (77.6%, 65.3%, and 50.5%), significantly outperforming the strongest baseline ( p = 0.015 p=0.015 ). For rare drug prediction, SMI-W achieves the highest Recall@15 (44.2%), significantly outperforming the strongest baseline G-BERT ( p = 0.0081 p=0.0081 ), showing that SMI is particularly effective for long-tailed fine-grained codes. These results suggest that aggregating frozen biomedical LM embeddings along ontology-grounded Semantic IDs benefits downstream clinical prediction, particularly rare drug prediction.
Compared with GRAM, which performs hierarchy-aware aggregation within a supervised prediction model, SMI constructs hierarchy-aware medical concept representations from frozen biomedical LM embeddings without task-specific training.
Compared with structure-aware encoders such as HiTs and OnT, which enforce structural consistency for individual concept embeddings, SMI explicitly aggregates hierarchy-level semantics into a final concept representation.
blocks.zh:
如表3所示,SMI和SMI-W不断改进对MIMIC-IV的临床预测。 SMI和SMI-W在AUPRC和AUROC方面普遍比基线更能实现死亡率和再入场预测。 在药物建议方面,收益特别明显,SMI-W取得了最好的AUPRC、F-分数和Jaccard分数(77.6%、65.3%和50.5%),显著地超过了最强的基准(p=0.015 p=0.015)。 对于罕见的药物预测,SMI-W实现最高的Recall@15(44.2%),显著地超过了最强的基准G-BERT(p=0.0081p=0.0081),表明SMI对长尾细纹码特别有效. 这些结果表明,将冰冻的生物医学LM嵌入到基于肿瘤的语义特征中,有利于下游的临床预测,特别是罕见的药物预测。
与在有监督的预测模型中进行分级认识聚合的GRAM相比,SMI构建了从冷冻生物医学LM嵌入的分级认识医学概念表述,而无需接受特定任务的培训.
相较于HiTs和OnT等结构感知编码器,它们为单个概念嵌入执行结构一致性,SMI明确将分级层次语义集为最终概念代表.

blocks.en: 4.5 SMI Mitigates Cross-Hospital Distribution Shift
blocks.zh: 4.5 SMI 跨医院分布移动

blocks.en: The multi-center eICU dataset exhibits substantial heterogeneity across hospitals in patient populations, clinical practice patterns, and data collection processes ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . We thus use hospital as the patient-group axis and evaluate cross-site distribution shift, as such heterogeneity can degrade the generalizability of learned patient representations. Specifically, we fit a hospital-specific VAE density model on patient embeddings encoded by either SMI or BioBERT ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) . For a source hospital k k and target hospital t t , we measured the shift by the log-likelihood gap: Δ = 𝔼 x k ​ [ log ⁡ p k ​ ( x k ) ] − 𝔼 x t ​ [ log ⁡ p k ​ ( x t ) ] \displaystyle\Delta=\mathbb{E}_{x_{k}}\left[\log p_{k}(x_{k})\right]-\mathbb{E}_{x_{t}}\left[\log p_{k}(x_{t})\right] (5)

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.6 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate SMI on clinical relation prediction by comparing BioBERT, SMI, and SMI-W (Table 4 ). BioBERT directly encodes each code description without using ontology structure. As shown in Table 4 , SMI consistently outperforms BioBERT across ICD, ATC, and ICD → \rightarrow ATC relation prediction, showing that simple aggregation of ontology path improves hierarchy-aware concept representation. SMI-W further improves over uniform SMI by selecting global level weights, suggesting that hierarchy levels contribute unequally to the final concept representation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较BioBERT、SMI和SMI-W(表4)来降低关于临床关系预测的SMI。 BioBERT直接将每个代码描述编码而不使用本体结构. 如表4所显示的,SMI在整个ICD,ATC,和ICD →\正弦ATC关系预测中,一直比BioBERT表现得更好,表明简单的肿瘤路径汇总可以提高分级意识概念的体现. SMI-W通过选择全球一级的权重,进一步改善了SMI的统一性,表明等级级别对最终概念代表的贡献不平等.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Our study makes the following key contributions. First, we propose SMI, a training-free framework that generates hierarchy-aware concept representations by integrating medical ontologies with LM embeddings. Second, we provide a theoretical analysis showing that SMI improves SNR and yields more informative embeddings. Third, qualitative analyses confirm that SMI learns clinically meaningful structures aligned with medical hierarchies. Finally, extensive experiments on clinical relation prediction, downstream clinical prediction, and cross-site distribution shift demonstrate the broad utility of SMI. The current study focuses on expert-curated coding systems such as ICD and ATC. Applying SMI to emerging disease classifications, newly introduced drugs, or local coding standards may require additional ontology validation and code mapping. For example, Canadian healthcare systems use ICD-10-CA or Drug Identification Numbers, which must be carefully mapped before deployment. Future work will extend SMI to clinician-validated ontology harmonization across coding systems, missing-link discovery, and broader biomedical knowledge resources. We will also study how to jointly integrate multiple ontologies within a unified SMI framework.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究作出了以下主要贡献。 首先,我们提出SMI,即一个无培训框架,通过将医学本体学与LM嵌入法相结合,产生分级意识的概念表述. 第二,我们提供了一项理论分析,表明SMI改进了SNR,并产生了更多的信息嵌入. 第三,定性分析证实,SMI学习了符合医学等级的临床有意义的结构. 最后,关于临床关系预测、下游临床预测和跨地点分布转移的广泛实验表明SMI的广泛用途。 目前的研究侧重于诸如ICD和ATC等由专家验证的编码系统. 将SMI应用于新出现的疾病分类,新引进的药物,或本地编码标准可能需要额外的肿瘤学验证和代码映射. 例如,加拿大保健系统使用ICD-10-CA或药物识别号码,在部署之前必须仔细绘制这些号码。 今后的工作将扩大SMI的范围,使其涵盖各编码系统、缺失链接发现和更广泛的生物医学知识资源等经临床鉴定的肿瘤学协调。 我们还将研究如何在一个统一的SMI框架内联合整合多种本体学.

blocks.en: B.6 Offset Consistency Analysis for Hierarchical Semantic Decomposition
blocks.zh: B.6 分级语义分解偏移一致性分析

blocks.en:
Assumption 3.5 models a child clinical concept as the composition of its parent concept semantics and a child-specific semantic offset, such as a complication, manifestation, or severity. This provides an approximate representation-level decomposition of fine-grained clinical concepts. To empirically assess this assumption,
We empirically assess this assumption by testing whether ICD-9 parent-child concept pairs sharing the same clinical modifier produce more consistent embedding offsets than parent-child pairs from different modifier groups. we use the clinical modifier expressed in each ICD-9 child description relative to its parent description as the child-specific semantic offset. For example, in the pair “diabetes mellitus” → \rightarrow “diabetes mellitus with renal manifestations,” the modifier is “renal manifestations.” We then test whether parent-child concept pairs sharing the same modifier produce more consistent embedding offsets than pairs from different modifier groups.
blocks.zh:
假设 3.5 模型 儿童临床概念是其母体概念语义的构成以及儿童特有的语义抵消,如复杂,表现,或严重. 这为细纹临床概念提供了近似代表层次分解. 为了从经验上评估这一假设,
我们通过测试ICD-9父子概念对共享同一种临床修饰剂是否产生比不同修饰剂组的母子对更相容的嵌入相抵消. 我们使用每个ICD-9儿童描述中表达的临床修饰剂 相对于其父母描述,作为特定儿童的语义抵消。 例如,在一对“二分母”中,修正语为“肾上腺表现”。 然后,我们测试分享同一修饰器的父子概念对子是否产生比不同修饰器组的对子更一致的嵌入抵消.

blocks.en: We construct the offset consistency analysis using the ICD-9 parent-child concept pairs. We define each decimal-level ICD-9 code as a child concept and use its integer-level ICD-9 code as the parent concept. Each ICD-9 code description is encoded using BioBERT with mean pooling over token embeddings. For each valid parent-child pair ( p , c ) (p,c) , we define the offset: Δ p , c LM = 𝐞 c LM − 𝐞 p LM , \Delta^{\mathrm{LM}}_{p,c}=\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{LM}}_{c}-\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{LM}}_{p}, where 𝐞 p LM \mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{LM}}_{p} and 𝐞 c LM \mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{LM}}_{c} denote the BioBERT embeddings of the parent and child descriptions, respectively. This offset represents the semantic change from a coarser parent concept to a more specific child concept in the LM embedding space.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ICD-9父子概念对构建相抵一致性分析. 我们把每一个小数级的ICD-9代码定义为一个儿童概念,并以它的整数级的ICD-9代码作为母概念. 每个 ICD-9 代码描述都使用 BioBERT 编码,平均集合在符号嵌入上. 对于每个有效的亲子配对(p,c)(p,c),我们定义了偏移: Δ p,c LM = e C LM- e LM,\Delta ^{\ mathrm{LM}}_{p,c}=\ mathbf{e}^{\ mathrm{LM}}_{c},其中e  p mathb{e}^{\ mathrm{LM}}_{p}分别表示父母和孩子的生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化活化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生化生 此偏移代表了LM嵌入空间中从相近父概念到更具体子概念的语义变化.

blocks.en: We group offsets by clinical modifiers extracted from the child description relative to the parent description. Modifier groups are extracted from the ICD-9 child description relative to its parent description using rule-based lexical patterns. We first identify explicit modifier cues, including with , without , due to , secondary to , and associated with ; when these cues are absent, we extract residual child-description terms after removing parent-description tokens. Extracted phrases are normalized by removing generic terms and canonicalizing common variants such as manifestation / manifestations and complication / complications . We further refine broad phrases into clinically specific modifier groups, including infection status, obstruction subtype, hepatic coma status, ophthalmic manifestations, retinal disorders, postpartum complications, delivery-related complications, and loss-of-consciousness status. Vague ICD descriptions containing terms such as unspecified , other , NEC , NOS , or not elsewhere classified are removed, and unresolved coarse buckets such as kidney/renal , circulatory/peripheral , and neurological are omitted from the strict analysis because they merge multiple clinically distinct semantic changes. For each selected modifier group, we normalize the offset vectors and compute all pairwise cosine similarities among offsets within that group. These pairs serve as positive pairs, since they compare parent-child offsets sharing the same clinical modifier. For the negative pairs, we sample offset pairs from different selected modifier groups. This comparison tests whether parent-child offsets with the same clinical modifier are more directionally consistent than randomly paired offsets with different modifiers in the same embedding space.
blocks.zh: 我们群体被取自儿童描述相对于父母描述的临床修饰剂所抵消. 修饰组是从ICD-9儿童描述中取出,相对于其父母描述,使用基于规则的词典模式. 我们首先确定明确的修改符号提示,包括: ,没有,因为, 次要到,并且与 有关; 当这些提示不存在时, 我们提取 剩余 的儿童描述术语 在删除 父母描述符号后。 被提取的短语通过去掉通用语来规范化,使常见的变体如表征/表征和复杂/复杂. 我们进一步将广义的短语细化为临床上特定的修饰群体,包括感染状态,阻塞亚型,肝昏迷状态,眼科表现,视网膜障碍,产后并发症,与分娩有关的并发症,以及失去意识状态等. 含有不明词等词的模糊 ICD描述被去除,如:不明词,其他词,NEC,NOS等,或别处分类的,未解决的粗桶如肾脏/肾脏,循环/腹部等,神经学在严格分析中被省略了,因为它们融合了多个临床上截然不同的语义变化. 对于每个选定的修饰器组,我们使抵消向量正常化,并计算该组内所有对等同位素相似性。 这些对子作为正对子,因为它们比较了父母-子女共享的同一种临床修饰剂. 对于负对,我们从不同的选定修饰组中取出样本来抵消对. 这种比较测试母子是否与同一种临床修饰剂相抵消,比同一种嵌入空间中与不同修饰剂相随机对接的抵消更具方向一致性.

blocks.en: After applying these selection criteria, the offset consistency analysis retains 418 modifier groups and 1,414 ICD-9 parent–child offsets, yielding 3,606 positive pairs with the same clinical modifier. The negative set consists of 50,000 randomly sampled offset pairs from different modifier groups. As shown in Table 6 , positive pairs with the same clinical modifier have substantially higher cosine similarity than negative pairs from different modifier groups. The mean cosine similarity is 0.655 0.655 versus 0.080 0.080 , with a median of 0.730 0.730 versus 0.068 0.068 and a mean difference of 0.575 0.575 ( p = 2.0 × 10 − 4 p=2.0\times 10^{-4} ). Fig. 5 shows that the same-modifier distribution is substantially shifted to the right relative to the different-modifier baseline. The distribution also contains both high-similarity and moderate-similarity regions, suggesting that some modifier families induce highly stable offsets while others remain more heterogeneous. This pattern is expected because ICD-9 modifiers vary in specificity and standardization. Overall, these results show that ICD-9 parent-child concept pairs sharing the same clinical modifier produce more aligned embedding offsets than pairs from different modifier groups. This supports the hierarchical semantic decomposition in Assumption 3.5 that fine-grained clinical concepts can be represented through parent-level semantics plus a child-specific semantic offset.

blocks.en: C.1 Construction of Medical Ontologies
blocks.zh: C.1 建筑医学肿瘤

blocks.en:
We explicitly incorporate domain knowledge to represent diagnoses, procedures, and medications using expert-defined, tree-structured medical ontologies. Each clinical concept is associated with a unique hierarchical path, capturing its semantic lineage from coarse clinical categories to fine-grained codes. This one-to-one mapping ensures that each clinical code has a distinct and interpretable position in the taxonomy.
These hierarchies define the structural relationships used to construct SMIs, allowing embeddings to encode clinically meaningful relationships consistent with expert knowledge.
blocks.zh:
我们明确纳入域知识,用专家定义的树状医学本体来表示诊断、程序和药物。 每个临床概念都与独特的分级路径相接,捕捉出其语义上从粗糙的临床类别到细纹编码. 这种一对一的绘图确保了每个临床代码在分类学中都有一个明确和可解释的位置.
这些分级定义了用于构建SMI的结构关系,使嵌入物能够按照专家知识编码临床有意义的关系.

blocks.en: Diagnostic concepts are organized using the CCS developed by the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ). CCS provides an expert-curated framework that groups ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes into clinically coherent categories at multiple levels of granularity. Based on this structure, we construct a five-level hierarchy comprising major categories, sub-categories, CCS codes, integer-level ICD codes, and decimal-level ICD codes. Each ICD code is uniquely assigned to a single hierarchical path, ensuring an interpretable and unambiguous disease representation.
blocks.zh: 诊断概念采用保健研究和质量局(AHRQ)制定的CCS组织。 CCS提供了一个经专家验证的框架,将ICD-9-CM和ICD-10-CM诊断代码归类为临床上一致的多等颗粒性类别。 基于这一结构,我们构建了由主要类别、分类别、CCS代码、整数级国际疾病分类代码和小数级国际疾病分类代码组成的五级体系。 每一个疾病分类代码都独一无二地被分配到单一的分级路径上,确保了可解释和毫不含糊的疾病表述.

blocks.en: Procedure concepts follow the CCS procedure hierarchy, which organizes ICD-9-PCS and ICD-10-PCS codes into a multi-level taxonomy. Specifically, procedures are structured from major categories and sub-categories to CCS procedure codes, followed by three-digit ICD-PCS codes and full ICD-PCS codes. This hierarchy captures progressively finer procedural distinctions while maintaining a unique parent–child relationship at each level, resulting in a well-defined tree structure suitable for embedding learning.
blocks.zh: 程序概念遵循CCS程序分级,将ICD-9-PCS和ICD-10-PCS编码组织成多层次分类. 具体而言,程序的结构从主要类别和子类别到CCS程序代码,然后是三位数的ICD-PCS代码和完整的ICD-PCS代码. 这种等级制度在保持每个级别独特的亲子关系的同时,会逐渐地细化程序上的区别,从而形成一个适合嵌入学习的明确界定的树结构。

blocks.en: Medication concepts are organized using the ATC classification system, which naturally defines a five-level hierarchy ranging from anatomical main groups to specific chemical substances. This expert-defined structure encodes pharmacological relationships among drugs and provides a clinically grounded hierarchy for representing medication concepts within the SMI framework.
blocks.zh: 药物化概念采用ATC分类系统来组织,该分类系统自然定义了从解剖学主要组类到特定化学物质等五级层次. 这种由专家定义的结构编码了药物之间的药理关系,并为在SMI框架内代表药物概念提供了基于临床的分级结构.

blocks.en: Across diagnoses, procedures, and medications, each clinical code is mapped to a unique hierarchical path, yielding a unified ontology that supports effective and interpretable representation learning with knowledge-based guidance.
blocks.zh: 在诊断、程序和药物方面,每个临床代码都绘制成独特的分级路径,形成一个统一的本体学,支持以知识为基础的指导进行有效和可解释的代表性学习。

blocks.en: C.2 Statistics of Medical Ontologies
blocks.zh: C.2 医学肿瘤统计

blocks.en: We adopt expert-defined clinical ontologies to represent diagnoses, procedures, and medications using multi-level hierarchical taxonomies. The summary statistics of clinical hierarchies are reported in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们采用专家定义的临床本体学来代表诊断、程序和药物,使用多层次分类法。 临床等级统计摘要见表7。

blocks.en: Diagnosis: Diagnosis concepts follow the CCS hierarchy, which organizes ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM codes into a five-level taxonomy. In total, CCS comprises 18 major disease categories, 134 subcategories, and 265 CCS codes, covering all ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM diagnostic concepts. At the fourth level, the hierarchy contains includes 2,175 integer-level ICD codes, comprising 937 ICD-9-CM codes and 1,278 ICD-10-CM codes. At the fifth level, the hierarchy further expands to decimal-level ICD diagnostic codes, including 13,193 ICD-9-CM and 73,066 ICD-10-CM codes, thereby providing the finest granularity.
blocks.zh: 诊断:诊断概念遵循CCS等级,将ICD-9-CM和ICD-10-CM编码组织为五级分类. CCS共有18个主要疾病类别,134个子类别和265个CCS代码,涵盖所有ICD-9-CM和ICD-10-CM诊断概念. 第四层次,分级包含2,175个整数级ICD代码,由937个ICD-9-CM代码和1,278个ICD-10-CM代码组成. 在第五层,分级进一步扩展为小数级ICD诊断代码,包括13,193个ICD-9-CM和73,066个ICD-10-CM代码,从而提供了最好的颗粒性.

blocks.en: Procedure: Procedure concepts follow the CCS hierarchy, which organizes ICD-9-PCS and ICD-10-PCS codes into a five-level taxonomy. Specifically, the hierarchy comprises 16 major categories, 200 subcategories, and 224 CCS codes, covering all ICD-9-PCS and ICD-10-PCS procedure codes. At the fourth level, procedure concepts are represented by three-digit ICD-PCS codes, comprising 876 ICD-9-PCS codes and 880 ICD-10-PCS codes. The fifth level corresponds to the full ICD-PCS codes, including 3,674 ICD-9-PCS codes and 80,492 ICD-10-PCS codes.
blocks.zh: 程序: 程序概念遵循CCS等级,将ICD-9-PCS和ICD-10-PCS代码组织为五级分类. 具体来说,等级包括16个主要类别、200个分类别和224个CCS代码,涵盖所有ICD-9-PCS和ICD-10-PCS程序代码。 第四层,程序概念由三位数的ICD-PCS代码代表,由876个ICD-9-PCS代码和880个ICD-10-PCS代码组成. 第五关对应完整的ICD-PCS代码,包括3,674个ICD-9-PCS代码和80,492个ICD-10-PCS代码.

blocks.en: Medication: Medication concepts follow the ATC classification system, which organizes drug codes into a five-level taxonomy. Specifically, the hierarchy comprises 14 anatomical main groups, 90 therapeutic subgroups, 248 pharmacological subgroups, 840 chemical subgroups, and 5,495 chemical substances (i.e., ATC codes).
blocks.zh: 药物化:药物化概念遵循ATC分类系统,将药物代码组织为五级分类. 具体来说,分级包括14个解剖学主要组别,90个治疗分群,248个药理分群,840个化学分群,以及5,495个化学物质(即ATC代码).

For ICD-CM and ICD-PCS levels, the # Concepts is reported as the total number of ICD-9 and ICD-10 codes shown in parentheses, respectively.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Experiment Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 实验细节

blocks.en: D.1 MIMIC Dataset Processing
blocks.zh: D.1 MIMIC 数据集处理

blocks.en: MIMIC-IV is a publicly available, de-identified EHR database derived from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) and released through PhysioNet under the PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License [ Johnson et al., 2023 ] . The database contains comprehensive longitudinal hospital and intensive care data collected from emergency department and inpatient admissions between 2008 and 2022. In this study, we use the hospital module of MIMIC-IV, which provides structured information on inpatient hospitalizations, including diagnoses, procedures, medication prescriptions, and admission and discharge timestamps. To ensure patient privacy, all identifiers are replaced with de-identified integer keys, and all timestamps are shifted by a patient-specific offset. This transformation preserves within-patient temporal ordering while preventing alignment of absolute calendar time across patients. After preprocessing, our cohort comprises 223,452 unique patients and 546,028 hospital admissions. On average, each patient has 2.44 hospital visits, forming longitudinal trajectories suitable for sequential modeling.
blocks.zh: MIMIC-IV是一个可公开查阅的,从Beth Israel Deaconess医学中心(BIDMC)衍生出来的EHR数据库,根据PhysioNet认证健康数据许可证通过PhysioNet发布[Johnson等,2023]. 该数据库载有2008年至2022年间从急诊部和住院中收集的综合纵向医院和重症监护数据。 在这项研究中,我们采用了MIMIC-IV的医院单元,该单元提供关于住院住院的有条理的信息,包括诊断、程序、药物处方以及入院和出院时间戳。 为了确保患者的隐私,所有识别符被去识别的整数键所取代,所有时间戳被一个患者特有偏移. 这种转变保持了病人内部的时间顺序,同时防止了病人之间绝对日历时间的一致。 经过预处理后,我们组群包括223 452名独特的病人和546 028名住院病人。 平均每名患者有2.44个医院出诊,形成适合相继建模的纵向轨道.

blocks.en:
Table 8: Basic statistics of the pre-processed MIMIC-IV EHR dataset.
“#” denotes counts and “/patient” denotes per-patient averages.
blocks.zh:
表8:预处理的MIMIC-IV EHR数据集的基本统计数据.
“#”表示计数,“/病人”表示每个病人的平均数。

blocks.en: We represent the EHR data using a visit-based formulation, where each visit corresponds to one inpatient hospitalization and each patient is modeled as a temporally ordered sequence of visits. Visits are ordered chronologically by admission time, while clinical concepts within a visit are treated as unordered sets, reflecting the episodic nature of hospital care. For each visit, we extract diagnostic and procedural information from the MIMIC-IV diagnoses and procedures tables. Diagnostic concepts are represented using the original ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM codes, with the coding system preserved via the recorded ICD version. After preprocessing, the dataset contains 9,143 unique ICD-9 diagnosis codes and 19,440 unique ICD-10 diagnosis codes. Procedural concepts are represented using ICD-9 and ICD-10-PCS procedure codes, yielding 2,557 unique ICD-9 procedure codes and 12,354 unique ICD-10 procedure codes in total. Within each visit, diagnoses and procedures are treated as unordered sets, while visit sequences for each patient preserve temporal order across admissions. Across the cohort, patients have on average 28.48 diagnosis codes and 3.85 procedure codes, aggregated over all visits.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一种基于探访的配方来代表紧急保健数据,每次探访相当于一次住院治疗,每个病人被作为按时间顺序排列的探访顺序。 探访按时间顺序排列,而探访期间的临床概念则作为无秩序的一组,反映了医院护理的典型性质。 每一次访问,我们都要从MIMIC-IV诊断和程序表中提取诊断和程序信息。 诊断概念使用最初的ICD-9-CM和ICD-10-CM编码来表示,编码系统通过所记录的ICD版本保存. 经过预处理,数据集包含9,143个独特的ICD-9诊断代码和19,440个独特的ICD-10诊断代码. 程序概念使用ICD-9和ICD-10-PCS程序代码表示,生成2,557个独特的ICD-9程序代码和12,354个独特的ICD-10程序代码。 在每次探访中,诊断和程序被作为无序的成套治疗,而每个病人的探访序列则保持了入院时间顺序。 在整个人群中,患者平均有28.48个诊断代码和3.85个程序代码,在所有访问中汇总。

blocks.en: Medication information is extracted from the MIMIC-IV prescriptions table, where drugs are originally recorded using National Drug Codes (NDC). Because NDC identifiers are highly granular and introduce substantial sparsity, we standardize medication concepts through a two-stage mapping process. Each NDC is first mapped to a corresponding RxNorm concept identifier (RxCUI), and each RxCUI is subsequently mapped to an Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code using a curated RxNorm–ATC reference. Unlike common practice that aggregates medications at higher ATC levels, we retain ATC level-5 codes, which correspond to specific chemical substances and preserve fine-grained pharmacological information. Not all NDC entries can be reliably mapped through this pipeline, for example due to non-drug supplies, institution-specific packaging codes, or missing references in external vocabularies. Following a strict standardization strategy consistent with prior work, unmappable NDCs are excluded from the medication representation. As a result, each visit’s medication set consists only of successfully mapped ATC level-5 codes. After preprocessing, the final medication vocabulary contains 1,286 unique ATC level-5 codes. Based on the processed dataset, approximately 85% of hospital admissions contain at least one mapped ATC-5 medication, computed as the fraction of visits with a non-empty ATC-5 medication set. Across all patients, the average number of medication codes per patient is 48.32, aggregated over their longitudinal visit histories.
blocks.zh: 从MIMIC-IV处方表中提取出药物信息,最初使用国家药品编码记录药物。 由于国家数据中心的识别器是高度颗粒化的,并引入了大量的螺旋体,我们通过两个阶段的绘图过程,使药物概念标准化。 每个NDC首先被映射到相应的RxNorm概念标识符(RxCUI)上,每个RxCUI随后被映射到一个使用被刻录出RxNorm–ATC参考的解剖治疗化学(ATC)分类码上. 与通常在较高ATC水平上汇总药物的做法不同,我们保留了ATC的5级编码,该编码对应特定的化学物质并保存了精细的药理信息. 并非所有的国家数据中心条目都能够通过这一管道可靠地绘制出地图,例如由于非药物供应、机构专用包装代码或外部词汇中缺少参考文献。 按照与以往工作相符合的严格标准化战略,无法适用的国家数据中心被排除在药品说明之外。 因此,每次访问的药物只包括成功绘制的ATC第5级密码。 经过预处理后,最终的药物词汇包含有1,286个独特的ATC级-5编码. 根据经过处理的数据集,大约85%的入院者至少含有一种图定的ATC-5药物,计算为非空的ATC-5药物的出院比例。 在所有患者中,每个患者的平均药物编码为48.32个,根据其纵向访问史汇总。

blocks.en: Based on the visit-based EHR representation, we construct training samples for multiple clinical prediction tasks using longitudinal sequences of inpatient hospitalizations. For each patient with a chronologically ordered visit sequence { x 1 , x 2 , … , x t } \left\{x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{t}\right\} , we generate a set of samples { ( x 1 ) , ( x 1 , x 2 ) , … , ( x 1 , x 2 , … , x t ) } \left\{\left(x_{1}\right),\left(x_{1},x_{2}\right),\ldots,\left(x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{t}\right)\right\} , where each sample corresponds to a prefix of consecutive visits. Each visit x i x_{i} is represented as an unordered set of diagnosis, procedure, and medication codes, while temporal dependencies are captured exclusively through the ordering of visits within the sequence. This unified formulation enables different clinical prediction tasks to share a consistent input representation, differing only in their target definitions and the specific visit used for supervision.

We consider four clinical prediction tasks. Mortality prediction (MT) aims to predict the in-hospital mortality outcome of the subsequent visit. Formally, given an input sequence ( x 1 , x 2 , … , x t − 1 ) \left(x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{t-1}\right) , the model predicts a binary label y ⁡ [ x t ] ∈ { 0 , 1 } y\left[x_{t}\right]\in\{0,1\} , where y ⁡ [ x t ] = 1 y\left[x_{t}\right]=1 indicates that the patient died during visit x i x_{i} ; the final visit of each patient is excluded from training since no future outcome is available. Readmission prediction (RA) predicts whether the patient will be readmitted within a predefined time window of σ \sigma days. Using the same input sequence ( x 1 , x 2 , … , x t − 1 ) \left(x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{t-1}\right) , the target label is defined as y ⁡ [ τ ⁡ ( x t ) − τ ⁡ ( x t − 1 ) ] ∈ { 0 , 1 } y\left[\tau\left(x_{t}\right)-\tau\left(x_{t-1}\right)\right]\in\{0,1\} , where τ ⁡ ( x i ) \tau\left(x_{i}\right) denotes the admission time of visit x i x_{i} , and y = 1 y=1 if τ ⁡ ( x t ) − τ ⁡ ( x t − 1 ) ≤ σ \tau\left(x_{t}\right)-\tau\left(x_{t-1}\right)\leq\sigma , and 0 0 otherwise. We set σ = 15 \sigma=15 days. The evaluation metrics is AUPRC and AUROC. Drug recommendation is formulated as a multi-label classification task, where the input sequence ( x 1 , x 2 , … , x t ) \left(x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{t}\right) is used to predict the set of medications prescribed during visit x t x_{t} . The target is represented as a multi-hot vector over the ATC level-5 medication vocabulary, whose dimensionality equals the number of unique drug types.
